note: The default approver roster (owner policy e251073ef3c5 item 3, 2026-10-05): who approves each Workbench action type, as operating/goal2_mc_approval.load_approver_roster reads it against operating/action_catalog.json (action_types "all" = every type the catalog declares). The same people are the MC admin/owner roster that re-checks gate deciders (mc_role), with the same action_types; an mc_role is recorded only with mc_role_source, and while no source states a person's MC role both are null: that person approves per call but decides no MC gate (decider_not_in_mc_roster). One rule for every approver, so a decider counts only for the types listed for them, a type-scoped approver approves its types per call at any host, and an empty list approves nothing. An oid is the person's Entra object id, recorded only with oid_source (where it was read: a read-only Graph /users lookup in the credentialed environment, who and when); it is never invented. While it is null, a host that serves actions resolves it at its start from the entry's UPN (its key) through the GET-only Graph /users read into its own state directory, never into this file (integrations/graph_directory.resolve_roster); while neither holds one the approver is refused: call_approver_oid_unknown for a per-call approval, decider_oid_unknown for an MC decision (operating/action_path.py). Vince can change this roster.
